name: Pseudodifferential operators
summary: Symbol calculus extended Calderon-Zygmund theory to PDE, then to propagation of singularities.

name: Fuzzy sets
summary: Graded membership generalised set theory for imprecise concepts.

name: Ax-Kochen
summary: Ultraproducts showed Artin's conjecture on p-adic forms holds for large primes.

name: Inverse scattering transform and Lax pairs for soliton equations
summary: The KdV equation from water waves and plasma physics is solved exactly through scattering data of a Schroedinger operator, and Lax recasts it as an isospectral flow.

name: Classification theory in model theory (Morley, Shelah)
summary: Categoricity in uncountable cardinals leads to stability and a dividing-line classification of first-order theories.

name: Chowla cosine problem via Cayley graph eigenvalues and MaxCut
summary: Showing that clique-free Cayley graphs must have very negative eigenvalues gave the first power-of-N lower bounds for the minimum of a sum of cosines, a problem posed in the 1950s-60s.

name: Kac-Moody algebras
summary: Generalised Cartan matrices gave infinite-dimensional algebras.

name: Twistor theory
summary: Penrose encodes spacetime fields as complex geometry.

name: Automata and formal verification
summary: Floyd and Hoare apply logic to program correctness.
